metadata.description: Apra Labs skills, agents, hooks and MCP servers for Claude Code

plugins.name: bitbucket
plugins.description: Bitbucket Cloud done right: REST and git authentication (API tokens with scopes, access tokens), repos, code, pull requests and reviews, pipelines and logs, deployments. The token stays in apra-fleet. Requires apra-fleet 0.4.4+ and Node.js 18+.

plugins.name: rport
plugins.description: Guardrails for RPort servers (rportd/openrport): stored tunnels, revive, expiry, repointing fleet members; the API token stays in apra-fleet. Requires apra-fleet 0.4.4+ and Node.js 18+.

plugins.name: redactor
plugins.description: Routes your MCP servers through apra-redactor-mcp, a local proxy that removes secrets and personal data from tool results before Claude sees them. Requires uv (the server runs via uvx from PyPI) or Docker; no apra-fleet needed.
